facts.statement: A Snow Days community party was held in the Wintery Basin fishing area on Server 1, with a US/Latin America session on Thursday December 9, 2010 at 3pm Pacific Time.
facts.quote: Thursday December 9th, 2010 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: A second Snow Days party session for UK and Europe was scheduled on Server 1 for Friday December 10, 2010 at 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT.
facts.quote: Friday December 10th, 2010 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT (UK and Europe) Server 1

facts.statement: Players were encouraged to wear wintery outfits and costumes and bring boomboxes to the party.
facts.quote: Wear your wintery outfits and costumes and bring your boomboxes.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms community event announcement for the Snow Days season party in the Wintery Basin fishing area above Snowhill. It gives the two scheduled server 1 times (Dec 9 for US/Latin America, Dec 10 for UK/Europe) and asks players to wear wintery outfits and bring boomboxes. The posting date is not shown; it was posted roughly five days before the December 14, 2010 capture.
